children: Gregory J. Henchel, an officer serving as EVP, Chief Legal Officer & Secretary, sold 30,000 shares of Class A common stock at $146.65 per share for a total of $4,399,500 on 2026-08-28, and following the transaction he directly owns 33,681 shares of Class A common stock.

Scott D. Lipesky, an officer serving as EVP, COO, sold 5,000 shares of Class A common stock at $149.00 per share for a total of $745,000 on 2026-08-28, and following the transaction he directly owns 147,534 shares of Class A common stock.

Rust Jay, an officer serving as EVP, Chief HR Officer, sold 5,000 shares of Class A common stock at $147.50 per share for a total of $737,500, and following the transaction he directly owns 15,651 shares of Class A common stock.
